results.title: EXCLUSIVE: Trump approval falls to 33%, lowest of his presidency, Reuters/Ipsos poll finds

results.content: Among respondents in the latest poll, 58% of registered Republicans said they think Trump is doing an “excellent” or “good” job as president, compared with 4% of Democrats and 18% of independents and those belonging to other parties.
